$description: COMPONENT tokens for Popover. The width is here for the same reason dialog.max-width is: a floating surface needs a stated width or its content decides, and a form inside a fit-content box is sized by its longest label. The inset is here because space.surface-padding is sized for a card or a dialog at 32rem; at a popover's 18rem it consumes a sixth of the box on each side and leaves 192px for content. Everything else Popover needs (radius.surface, elevation.overlay, color.surface.elevated, color.border, every motion role) is semantic and stays semantic.

width.$description: 288px. Wide enough for a short form row or a paragraph, narrow enough to sit beside its trigger on a tablet. Override with className for a wider surface; the max-width clamp to the viewport still applies.

padding.$description: 16px. Two thirds of space.surface-padding, which is the ratio at which a 288px surface still reads as a surface rather than as a frame around its content.
